Container.Name: filearr-agent
Container.Overview:
Standalone Filearr inventory agent: walks your Unraid shares into a local offline-first catalog (SQLite) and replicates the inventory to your central Filearr server over mutual TLS. Central does the heavy metadata extraction after replication; the agent stays a lightweight, read-only walker.
FIRST START: mint an enrollment token in the Filearr console (Agents -> Mint enrollment token, single-use, short TTL) and paste it below together with your central URL. The agent enrolls once, stores its identity in appdata, and never needs the token again.
The /mnt/user mount is 1:1 and read-only, so the paths central records match your real Unraid paths — no path mapping needed. Scans re-run on an interval (inotify is unreliable on /mnt/user's FUSE mount, so there is no watch mode here).
If your central Filearr runs on this same Unraid box, switch Network to the 'filearr' custom network so the URL can be http://filearr:8000.
Container.Requires: a running central Filearr server (any host) + one enrollment token minted from its console

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Agent identity (key/cert), local SQLite index + replication outbox, scan config. Keep on the cache pool.

Config.Name: User shares
Config.Description: Read-only, 1:1 (container path = host path) so recorded paths match Unraid natively. Narrow this to a single share (e.g. /mnt/user/media on both sides) if you don't want everything visible to the agent.

Config.Name: Central URL
Config.Description: Your central Filearr server, e.g. https://filearr.example.com — the agent only ever connects outbound.

Config.Name: Enrollment Token
Config.Description: Single-use token from the console (Agents -> Mint enrollment token). Consumed on first successful start; safe to clear afterwards.

Config.Name: Agent Name
Config.Description: Friendly name shown in the central console's Agents page.

Config.Name: Scan Roots
Config.Description: Comma-separated directories to inventory (must be under a mounted path). Tip: list specific shares (/mnt/user/media,/mnt/user/documents) instead of all of /mnt/user to skip appdata/system churn. NOTE: roots merge into scan.json — removing one here does not remove it from the agent; edit appdata's scan.json for that.

Config.Name: Scan Interval
Config.Description: Rescan cadence (Go-style duration: 30m, 6h, 24h). Rescans are mtime+size cheap — unchanged files cost a stat.

Config.Name: Scan On Start
Config.Description: Run a scan immediately at container start (false = wait one interval first).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: error | warn | info | verbose | debug (logs go to the container log).

Config.Name: Extra CA Bundle
Config.Description: Path to a PEM bundle of extra trusted server roots, for a central behind a private CA. Mount the file under /config and point this at it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the agent runs as (Unraid default: 99/nobody). Needs read access to the scanned shares.
